component.name: Mirivue KDE
component.summary: Browse, organise and analyse multimedia files
Parcourir, organiser et analyser les fichiers multimédias

description.p: Mirivue is a dual-pane file manager for KDE Plasma with multimedia previews, metadata analysis and native KIO file operations.
Hidden items stay hidden during navigation. Publication source verification supports RPM 6 archive paths.
Hidden items remain hidden after folder navigation and opening tabs until explicitly shown by the user.
The configured startup rule for hidden items now applies to all initial folders and restored tabs. Reactivating an existing window preserves its current visibility.
Bulk rename word capitalization now normalizes existing uppercase words while preserving file extensions. The method label is clearer.
Stable release: exact KIO file operations, cancellable KDE confirmations with undo history preserved, folder rename refresh and complete multimedia runtime dependencies.
Mirivue est un gestionnaire de fichiers à deux panneaux pour KDE Plasma, avec aperçus multimédias, analyse des métadonnées et opérations de fichiers natives KIO.
